hysteroscopic fenestration with precise incision of the complete uterine septum and double cervix preservation
Hysteroscopic fenestration with precise incision of the complete uterine septum and double cervix preservation
outcome: MRI and hysteroscopic changes of uterus
cohort: 24 patients with complete septate uterus and double cervix
finding: Hysteroscopic fenestration with precise incision of the uterine septum and double cervix preservation is an effective surgical procedure for complete septate uterus and double cervix, resulting in improved uterine morphology, symptom relief, and positive reproductive outcomes.
mod_finding: Two live births were delivered by cesarean section and 4 by vaginal delivery without cervical incompetence during pregnancy.
